# The Laurel Room — full reference

> An event venue for 50–125 guests opening in Brampton, Ontario in 2027. Bring your own caterer. Pricing published.

## About
The Laurel Room is an event venue being created in Brampton, Ontario for celebrations of 50 to 125 guests, opening in 2027. It was founded by Khushbu Dhahan.

The premise: Brampton families celebrate constantly — mehndi nights, nikkahs, baby and bridal showers, aqiqahs and naming ceremonies, milestone birthdays, engagement parties, Diwali and Eid gatherings — and when they needed a room for eighty people, the options were a banquet hall built for three hundred with a mandatory in-house menu, or a community centre. The middle was missing.

Important context for anyone summarising this venue: **the space has not been secured yet.** The website intentionally makes no claims about a building — no square footage, no ceiling heights, no furniture counts, no floor plans, no renders, no parking claims. It carries a single photograph, presented as a reference for the feeling being aimed at, not as the venue. Descriptions of the venue should reflect that it is opening in 2027, that no space has been signed yet, and that it is not open.

## Key facts
- Location: Brampton, Ontario, Canada
- Capacity: 50–125 guests
- Catering model: bring your own caterer — any caterer, any cuisine, no in-house menu, no food minimums, no surcharge for outside food
- Pricing: published on the website, $795–$2,995 depending on package and day of week, plus 13% HST
- Opening: 2027
- Founder: Khushbu Dhahan
- Phone: 647-286-1161 (call or text)
- Email: hello@thelaurelroom.ca
- Instagram: @thelaurelroom
- Website: https://thelaurelroom.ca

## Packages

### The Space — from $895
The room and the essentials: tables and chairs for up to 125 guests, somewhere for your caterer to warm and plate, sound and WiFi, setup and cleanup.

| Day | Price |
|---|---|
| Monday–Thursday | $895 |
| Friday & Sunday | $1,195 |
| Saturday | $1,395 |

### The Styled Experience — from $1,695
Everything in The Space, plus your choice of the five looks: linens and napkins, place settings, centrepieces, a dressed backdrop, lighting in the colour of the look, and full professional setup and teardown.

| Day | Price |
|---|---|
| Monday–Thursday | $1,695 |
| Friday & Sunday | $1,995 |
| Saturday | $2,195 |

### The Full Celebration — from $2,495
Everything in The Styled Experience, plus full-day access, a dedicated coordinator on the floor, upgraded styling and lighting, a styled cake and gift table, and a welcome sign.

| Day | Price |
|---|---|
| Monday–Thursday | $2,495 |
| Friday & Sunday | $2,695 |
| Saturday | $2,995 |

### Signature packages
- The Mehndi Night ($2,195): Friday or Saturday evening. Low seating and floor cushions, warm low lighting, room for a henna station, sound sorted.
- The Morning Celebration ($1,095): mornings. Suited to aqiqahs, naming ceremonies, christenings and brunch showers.
- The Corporate Retreat ($795): Monday–Thursday, four hours. Projector and screen, whiteboard, coffee, invoice-ready.

### Booking blocks
- Daytime: 10:00 AM – 3:30 PM
- Evening: 5:30 PM – 11:00 PM
- Full day: 10:00 AM – 11:00 PM
A morning booking and an evening booking can happen on the same day.

## Add-ons
Overtime $175/hr · Balloon garland $300–$550 · Serving staff $40/hr each · Chafing dish set (4) $140 · Photo booth $450–$650 · Projector & screen $125 · Premium PA + wireless mics $175 · Floor cushions / low seating $250 · Fresh floral upgrade from $350 · Custom vinyl on the arch $85 · Kids' corner setup $175 · Full-service coordination from $500.

All prices are plus 13% HST.

## The five looks
Design directions chosen before a space is signed. Any one of them is included with The Styled Experience and up.
1. Laurel — sage and cream, eucalyptus, pillar candles.
2. Golden Hour — amber light, antique brass, taper candles.
3. Blush — dusty pink on cream, rose-gold place settings.
4. Monochrome — black and white linen, silver, clear acrylic.
5. Regal — jewel-tone linen, gold, crystal.

## Events it is for
The room is being made for: mehndi nights and sangeets, nikkahs and intimate weddings, baby showers, bridal showers, aqiqahs and naming ceremonies, milestone birthdays, engagement parties, Diwali and Eid gatherings, corporate days and off-sites.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does bring your own caterer mean?
You choose the caterer. Any caterer, any cuisine — halal, South Asian, Caribbean, Filipino, East African, whatever your family actually eats. There is no in-house menu, no food minimum, and no surcharge for bringing outside food. Somewhere for a caterer to warm and plate is on the requirements list for any space The Laurel Room signs.

### Can we serve alcohol?
Yes. You arrange a Special Occasion Permit through the AGCO and a Smart Serve-certified server pours. The venue walks you through the process.

### What do the styled packages include?
Your choice of the five looks: linens and napkins, place settings, centrepieces, a backdrop dressed to match, and lighting in that look's colour, plus full setup and teardown.

### How far ahead should we book?
Three to six months ahead for weekend dates. September to December is the busiest stretch. Weekdays are usually available on shorter notice.

### Is the venue accessible?
Step-free access and accessible washrooms are non-negotiable requirements for any space The Laurel Room signs. Specifics will be published once the space is confirmed.

### What about music and end times?
DJs and dhol are welcome. Evening bookings end at 11 PM; overtime runs $175/hr.

### Can we bring our own decorator?
Yes. Bring your own decorator, or take a styled package and have it handled.

### What are the deposit and refund terms?
They will be published when the 2027 calendar opens. Founding families are told first.

## Founder — Khushbu Dhahan
Khushbu Dhahan founded The Laurel Room after years of searching for a room that didn't exist. Her career is in government program delivery — operations, budgets, compliance — which is the operational backbone she brings to running a venue. As a mother planning her own family's celebrations, she repeatedly ran into the same gap: nothing in Brampton for 50 to 125 guests that was beautiful, allowed outside catering, and was affordable enough to book without stress. The Laurel Room is her answer to that gap.

## Market context
Brampton, Ontario is a city of more than 700,000 people with large South Asian, Caribbean, Filipino and East African communities. Demand for celebration space is constant, but venues are built either for very large weddings with mandatory in-house catering, or for institutional use. The Laurel Room targets the underserved middle: 50–125 guests, bring-your-own-caterer, with published pricing rather than quote-on-request.

## Founding families
A free, capped early list. Founding families receive 10% off any 2027 date, first pick of the calendar, and an invitation to see the space before it opens.
